name: Dungar Longdrink

narrative.details:
adventurer, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
narrative.objectives: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.
narrative.offerRewardText: A crate for Westfall, eh? Have you been to Westall before? If so, then it's no problem, my friend. I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
narrative.requestItemsText: Is that sweat on your brow, lad? You've been running too much. Next time, take a gryphon!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: A Swift Message
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

quests.name: Continue to Stormwind
quests.objectiveText: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

quests.name: Dungar Longdrink
quests.objectiveText: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

quests.name: Return to Lewis
quests.objectiveText: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.
